justification: Lower bounds and the Infant/Child/Adolescent/Adult upper bounds follow the cMD age_group slot definition (Infant >=1 month & <2 yrs, Child >=2 & <11, Adolescent >=11 & <18, Adult >=18 & <65, Elderly >=65). The schema gives Elderly no upper bound; 130 is the curation convention used in the cMD gold tables (743 group-only Elderly rows encode age_max=130 at curatedMetagenomicDataCuration commit 41271711). Newborn (<1 month) is omitted because it is defined in sub-year units. age_min/age_max are in years; the cMD slot description states they are identical for a specific age.
